## AI Agent Interaction (WebMCP)

This website supports WebMCP (Model Context Protocol for the Web). AI agents can use the following registered tools:
- `searchPortfolio`: Search through Brian's work, projects, and references.
- `contactForFreelance`: Get contact information for hiring Brian for freelance missions.
